newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour stretches opinion poll lead.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour stretches opinion poll lead.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has increased its commanding lead over the ruling Conservatives ahead of the May 1 general election, according to an opinion poll in Thursday's edition of The Times newspaper.

The MORI poll gives Labour 55 percent support, up five points from a week ago, with the Conservatives on 28 percent, down one point, and the minority centrist Liberal Democrats on 11 percent, down three points.

The poll appeared to undermine Conservative hopes that they had started to narrow Labour's lead as the election approaches, suggesting that the ruling party had been damaged by persistent reports of alleged sex and money scandals.
MORI interviewed 1,118 adults at 84 sampling points on a face-to-face basis on Tuesday.
